A '''flewt''' was a species of predatory [[Butterfly/Legends|butterfly]] that was found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|I can't talk with these starving flewts all over the place! They won't stop yammering about how hungry they are.|Kippy Martin|<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Kippy Martin]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill starving flewts that bothered her in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Butterfly_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Flewts appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
